div.head: II Ew 2
div.ab: ⁊ gif hit se gerefa ne amanige mid rihte on ðara manna gewitnesse, ðe him to gewitnesse getealde syndon, þonne bete mine oferhyrnesse mid CXX scll'.
⁊ gyf hit se gerefa ne amanige mid rihte on ðara manna gewitnesse, ðe him to gewitnesse getealde syndon, ðonne bete mine oferhyrnesse CXX scyl'.
Et si prepositus [non] moneat rectitudinem per eorum testimonium, qui testes adnumerati sunt ei, reddat oferhyrnessam meam.
[Be gerefan ðe mid riht ne amanige.] ⁊ gif hit se gerefa ne amanige mid rihte on ðara manna gewitnesse, ðe him to gewitnesse getealde syndon, þonne bete mine oferhyrnesse mid CXX scll'.

(Vom Gerichtsvogt, welcher nicht ordnungsmässig eintreibt. Ld) Und wenn es der [königliche] Gerichtsvogt nicht ordnungsmässig unter Zeugniss derjenigen Männer eintreibt, welche ihm als Zeugenschaft zugezählt sind, dann büsse er den Ungehorsam gegen mich mit 120 Schll.

(Of the reeve who does not exact properly. Ld) And if the [royal] reeve does not exact it properly, in the witness of those men who are assigned to him as witnesses, then let him pay [for] disobedience to me with 120 shillings.

And if the reeve does not exact it [the fine] in accordance with the law, and in the presence of men who have been assigned to him as witnesses, he shall pay 120 shillings compensation for insubordination to me.

Delay of execution; cf. Cohn Justizverweigerung 112. See Gl Ungehorsam 6; Amtsvergehen 1. — II As 25 later introduces the bishop as collector of the fine forfeited by the reeve

Liebermann takes this to mean that a number of men are nominated to act as witnesses for the reeve when he exacts the fines mentioned in § 3, above. According to II As. cap. 25 § 1, the fine incurred by the reeve is to be exacted by the bishop.
